description: A curved flake of shell that runs green to gold as you turn it. The dune keeps giving these up.
lore: Somebody on the dune circuit worked out that a flake on a wire turns in the wind, and a turning flake throws green, then gold, then nothing, over and over, further into the dark than firelight carries. So the dune fires wear collars of them now: two dozen strung along a wire between the stones, flashing all night, so that a person out there with no idea where they are has something to walk at.

The wire outlasts the keeper. [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] has come in on four of them and found cold stones and no one, and he has left every wire hanging. His reasoning is short and he does not offer it twice: the flashing still fetches a stranger to a windbreak, a ring of stones and somewhere out of the sand, and that is not nothing, and it is a great deal more than the dark straight on.
gm_notes: A lapsed fire that goes on signalling. Any dune fire can be introduced by its wire flashing from a mile out; whether anybody is still at it is what the player finds out by walking to it. Gunnar's four are on his map and he has not mentioned them to Solveig.
